decisions.reason: As a flagship multi-model range that is very close to the firm’s core safety-footwear know-how, it fits the firm’s strong absorptive capacity and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.
This electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe remains close to established technical and market capabilities, so the firm is likely to retain it unless early demand proves persistently too narrow.
A safety shoe series with several models sits squarely within the firm’s existing product-development base, making continued refinement and market support more likely than exit.
